# Flavor Isle

> Flavor Isle is a family-owned burger and shake diner at 103 N Main St, Smiths Grove, KY 42171, about 0.7 miles off I-65 Exit 38. Serving since 1964. Hand-patted burgers, fresh-cut fries and thick shakes, eaten at the counter, in the dining room or from the walk-up window. Delivery is paused: pickup, curbside and dine-in only.

## Key facts

- Name: Flavor Isle
- Address: 103 N Main St, Smiths Grove, KY 42171
- Highway: 0.7 miles from I-65 Exit 38, about 15 minutes north of Bowling Green
- Hours: Monday-Saturday 10:30 AM - 7:00 PM; Sunday 11:00 AM - 7:00 PM; kitchen closes 30 minutes before close
- Diner phone: (270) 563-4618
- Phone ordering and texting (Smashie, the AI ordering line): (270) 563-7230
- Order online: https://flavor-isle.com/menu
- Fulfillment: pickup, curbside, dine-in, walk-up window. Delivery is paused.
- Price range: $ (minis under $2, most burgers $5-$9)
- Payment: card online and at the counter, cash accepted
- Happy hour: 2:00-6:00 PM, half off drinks
- Serves: burgers (single, double, bacon, mushroom Swiss, minis), chicken and handhelds, fries and curly fries, thick shakes and soft serve, combos and drinks
- Family-owned since 1964. About 15 minutes from Mammoth Cave by way of Exit 38.
- Parking: easy parking near the diner, room for trucks and trailers
